shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite movie is a great adventure story.
Traveling to new places brings me joy.
I often cook dinner for my family on weekends.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
My friend and I enjoy playing soccer together each week.
I like to explore new restaurants in my city.
Gardening is a satisfying hobby that brings me peace.
Volunteering at the shelter gives me a sense of purpose.
Learning a new language can be challenging but rewarding.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your typical daily meals?
Q2: Have you ever faced challenges in maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: What is your opinion on following a vegetarian or vegan lifestyle?
Q4: What advice would you give someone trying to improve their eating habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise routines.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you encountered any obstacles that prevent you from exercising regularly?
Q3: How important do you think physical activity is for mental health?
Q4: What tips would you share with someone who wants to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about reading habits.
questions: Q1: What kind of books do you prefer to read?
Q2: Have you experienced any difficulties in finding time to read?
Q3: In your opinion, how does reading benefit a person's life?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone who wants to read more?
